title: Krishna Gopal Pandey v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amitava Lala, J.; Ashok Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; estimate dispute left to s.42(5)/cl.7.10 forum.
headnote: A dispute over the licensee's unpaid estimate for an electricity connection is a factual grievance for the statutory forum under s.42(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with cl.7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, not the writ court. The petition was dismissed, with liberty to proceed in accordance with law.
facts: The petitioner, Krishna Gopal Pandey, moved the Allahabad High Court alleging that despite a Division Bench order of 13 January 2011 and subsequent contempt-court directions, the respondent electricity authority had still not given him a connection. The respondents' case was that they had sent an estimate for the connection which remained unpaid. The petitioner disputed that estimate.

holding_units.holding: A dispute over the licensee's estimate for an electricity connection cannot be decided on the writ side. Section 42(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (and the 2007 Regulations) is the appropriate forum for such factual grievances; the writ was dismissed with liberty to proceed in accordance with law.

not_decided.point: Whether the estimate for the electricity connection was correct or payable
not_decided.note: Merits of the estimate dispute left to the statutory grievance forum.
